fusions.name: Sounding Pulse
fusions.desc: Sends out a pulse of pressure that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, stuns each for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Skimmed Drink
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy up to 5 tiles away: it deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 6% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 30%. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Grotto
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and restores 8 health. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Stalactite Seep
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%. You regenerate 0.5 health a second at all times.
